# appgatesdp_on_boarded_devices (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `descending` (String) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `order_by` (String) The field name to sort the result list. Supported fields vary from object to object. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `query` (String) Query string to filter the result list. It's used for various fields depending on the object type. Send multiple query parameters to make the queries more specific.
- `range` (String) 'Range string to limit the result list. Format: -. 3-10 means the items between the (including) 3rd and the 10th
 will be returned. Defaults to all objects.'

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of Registered Devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `filter_by` (Attributes List) The filters applied to the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_by))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `queries` (List of String) The queries applied to the list.
- `total_count` (Number) The total readable count of entities. Not influenced by the query.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) The device ID, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `device_type` (String) Type of the registered device.
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of a user&device combination. Format: "CN=,CN=,OU="
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the Device at the time of registration, sent by the Device.
- `last_seen_at` (String) The time when the device last signed in. 'null' if it has signed in last on a Controller that was older than 5.4 at the time.
- `on_boarded_at` (String) Registration time.
- `provider_name` (String) The provider name of the user, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `username` (String) The username, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.

Read-Only:
